import base64, hmac, hashlib, json, time, urllib.request
def b64u(b): return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b).rstrip(b"=")
hdr = b64u(json.dumps({"alg":"HS256","typ":"JWT"}).encode())
pld = b64u(json.dumps({"sub":"1","user_id":1,"username":"admin","role":"admin","exp":int(time.time())+3600}).encode())
sig = b64u(hmac.new(b"change-me-in-production", hdr + b"." + pld, hashlib.sha256).digest())
tok = (hdr + b"." + pld + b"." + sig).decode()
for url in [
    "http://127.0.0.1:8083/api/snapshot-progress?page=1&page_size=3",
    "http://127.0.0.1:8083/api/activity-log?page=1&limit=4&operation=snapshot.v2",
    "http://127.0.0.1:8083/api/activity-log?page=1&limit=3&target_table=cdc_transaction_history_payload_1"
]:
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + tok})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as resp:
        print("URL:", url)
        print(resp.read().decode())
